subject: Pricing & discounts - startup program + committed-use options
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@deepfin.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery - inference costs & next steps

Hi Marissa \u0014

Thanks again for the call earlier. To recap from our side: DeepFin expects to start at ~5M tokens/month and ramp to ~20M tokens/month by Q2 as we add features. Rough budget range we have for inference is about $1k\u0013$6k/month right now. Our procurement team prefers to see target unit economics so we can model this.

Top asks:
- Can you confirm list unit price per 1M tokens for the model we discussed (encoder-decoder variant)?
- Do you have committed-use pricing (12mo / 24mo) and any startup program discounts (credits or first-month reductions)?
- If possible, please provide an example P&L for 5M, 12M, and 20M tokens/month showing monthly cost and effective $/1M tokens.

We\u0019d like to evaluate a 12-month committed-use if the numbers can get us into the $/1M tokens range of ~ $200 (ballpark) or better. Also open to 24mo if there\u0019s a material multi-year incentive. Procurement cc'd (procurement@deepfin.ai).

I attached our short usage profile (DeepFin_eval_summary.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Alice
Head of Product, DeepFin AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@deepfin.ai>
Cc: procurement@deepfin.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery - inference costs & next steps

Hi Alice \u0014 great to chat yesterday, and thanks for the summary. Appreciate the clear asks. Below is a concise set of options so you can model out the scenarios quickly. Attaching our pricing sheet and an example quote.

Quick assumptions (based on model/config we discussed):
- Baseline list price (no discounts): $200 per 1M tokens (this reflects the curated model + hosting/observability features we\u0019d run for you).
- Optimizations: with batching + prefix caching we typically see a 10% effective cost improvement for conversational workloads; I show both list and optimized numbers below.

Scenarios (monthly / effective $/1M):
- 5M tokens/month (low):
  - List: 5 * $200 = $1,000/mo (=$200/1M)
  - With typical runtime optimizations (-10%): $900/mo (=$180/1M)
- 12M tokens/month (mid):
  - List: 12 * $200 = $2,400/mo (=$200/1M)
  - With optimizations: $2,160/mo (=$180/1M)
- 20M tokens/month (target ramp):
  - List: 20 * $200 = $4,000/mo (=$200/1M)
  - With optimizations: $3,600/mo (=$180/1M)

Discounting options we can offer (subject to final approval):
1) Startup program:
   - $10k platform credit applied over the first 6 months + 25% off list price for the first 6 months.
   - Example (20M/mo): first 6 months unit price = $150/1M -> 20 * $150 = $3,000/mo (then reverts to list/committed pricing).
2) Committed-use (12mo):
   - 12-month commit at an average of your forecasted usage (we can set a floor/true-up).
   - 20% off list price if you commit to the 12mo plan at the 20M/mo forecast -> effective $160/1M.
   - For 20M/mo: 240M tokens/year * $160/1M = $38,400/year (~$3,200/mo).
3) Multi-year (24mo):
   - Additional incentive available for 24mo (up to ~30% off list, exact depends on firm commitment level and payment terms).

Recommended next steps:
- If you\u0019d like to model exact costs for procurement, we can produce a formal quote with a commit schedule and true-up terms.
- If you\u0019re leaning startup program + short commit, we can draft a 6mo startup + optional 12mo committed-use quote for procurement review.

I attached: Quote_DeepFin_Redwood_20261115.pdf (pro forma) and RDW_pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx.

Would you be open to a short call with procurement + engineering next week to finalize the commit/profile? If so, propose Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks \u0014
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:25:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: DeepFin pricing ask \u0014 approve startup + commit?

Aditya / Ben \u0014 looping you in on DeepFin. They\u0019re a seed-stage infra/fintech startup with an expected ramp 5->20M tokens/mo. Procurement is asking for target $/1M ~ $200. My proposed flexibility:

- Offer startup package: $10k credit + 25% off list for first 6 months (this meaningfully lowers first-6mo effective cost).
- Commit option: 12mo at 20% off list if they sign for ~20M/mo average (true-up mechanism).
- If they push 24mo we can add an additional ~10% incentive (so ~30% total) depending on payment cadence.

As usual, want your OK to include the startup credit and the 20% commit discount in a formal quote. If OK I\u0019ll send the DocuSign link and start procurement thread. I\u0019ve attached the pro-forma quote.

Thanks \u0014
Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DeepFin pricing ask \u0014 approve startup + commit?

Marissa \u0014 good plan, approve the startup package (10k credit + 25% off for 6mo) and the 12mo 20% committed-use discount for the 20M/mo profile. Please include a clause for a quarterly true-up (standard) and an option to convert to 24mo for an additional 10% discount (requires sign-off from sales leadership).

Ben \u0014 please prep a formal quote with the above terms and the HubSpot deal id RDW-2026-DF-89. Once you have the DocuSign envelope ready, Marissa can send to procurement.

Aditya
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
